description: This file defines the CustomUserSettingsService class, which manages user-specific content type settings within OrchardCore, including retrieving and merging user settings based on content type definitions.

classes.name: CustomUserSettingsService
classes.description: Service class for managing custom user settings, including retrieving settings types and content items for users.

methods.name: GetAllSettingsTypeNamesAsync
methods.description: Returns all available settings type names.

methods.name: GetSettingsTypesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves specific settings type definitions by their names.

methods.name: GetSettingsTypeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a single settings type definition by name.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves user settings content items for a given settings type name.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves user settings content items for a given ContentTypeDefinition.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user's settings content item for a given ContentTypeDefinition.

methods.name: GetContentTypeAsync
methods.description: Fetches content type definitions with the stereotype 'CustomUserSettings'.
